summary: FD_TC_096_No Determination | Disruption on Star Alliance Partner | APPR
title: No Determination | Disruption on Star Alliance Partner | APPR
description:
Disrupted leg operated by a Star Alliance partner (Lufthansa). AC systems have the flight timing data � scheduled and actual arrival times, delay duration � and can identify the MSL. DDS determines MSL = Lufthansa-operated leg. Since Lufthansa is a Star Alliance partner, AC does not auto-assess but instead creates a StarQuest case and forwards it to an agent for manual handling with the partner. The system has all the data; the reason for manual routing is the Star Alliance partnership, not missing data.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Francine Dub�), 2 legs YUL?FRA?MUC.
Leg 1 (YUL?FRA): AC operated, on time. Scheduled arrival: 07:30. Actual arrival: 07:25.
Leg 2 (FRA?MUC): Operated by Lufthansa (LH 471). Scheduled arrival: 11:00. Actual arrival: 15:00 (4hr delay).
MSL: Leg 2 (LH 471) � 4hr delay is the most significant disruption.
MSL Carrier: Lufthansa (LH) � Star Alliance partner.
DDS Action: MSL identified on Star Alliance partner ? AC does not auto-assess ? StarQuest case created ? forwarded to agent for manual handling.
